engine: InboxShield v7.0 Passive DNS Protocol Engine (Node.js native dns/promises + Cloudflare DoH cross-check)
methodology: Strictly passive public DNS audit of 60 iconic SaaS & AI startup apex domains across 6 categories (10 each) on 2026-11-23. Checks authoritative NS/SOA, MX redundancy, recursive SPF include expansion (RFC 7208), 24 standard DKIM selectors, strict RFC 7489 DMARC policy, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, CAA, and 5 DNSBLs. Zero intrusive traffic.
